candidate_relations.reason: Lytic lesions, 80% clonal κ-restricted plasma cells, and monoclonal IgG-κ support multiple myeloma; however, the requested diagnosis also requires type I cryoglobulinemia causing the thrombotic purpura.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying plasma cell malignancy but omits the associated type I cryoglobulinemia.
